# Bill fixtures

`lb542_excerpt.txt` and `am2839_excerpt.txt` keep only the structural lines (title, operative clauses, and a few
cross-reference sentences) of LB542 (109th Legislature, 1st Session) and amendment AM2839 to LB959, copied from the
drafting-system text. Bodies are replaced with `[body omitted]`. Full bills are not stored here.

Everything else under this folder is synthetic and written to exercise one edge case at a time.
